# Pinned MaaFramework Runtime

`win-x86_64/MaaWin32ControlUnit.dll` is built from
`Tortes/MaaFramework@d6381bd76171647463d62358f6fed01f2a613d79` using the
`RelWithDebInfo` configuration. The commit is based on MaaFramework v5.11.0
and adds Interception `RelativeMoveInput` support.

The expected SHA-256 is recorded in `maaframework.lock.json` and verified by
the release workflow before packaging.
